rationale: With only 27 minutes to close, the stock has already made a large gap-up move (~5% from prior close) on strong earnings news and is now showing a slight pullback from the session high ($172.95) with the last candle closing below its open — momentum is fading near the top of the range. The 9-EMA ($170.47) is essentially at current price ($170.42), offering no clear directional edge, and the ATR-based risk/reward within the remaining time window is unfavorable given the tight spread but wide intraday range already realized. Entering long chases a move that is largely exhausted, while shorting a strong earnings catalyst with elevated relative volume (3.26x) carries significant squeeze risk in the final 27 minutes.
